description: Average anchor points (Object > Path > Average): move them onto one horizontal line, one vertical line, or one point. Handles move with their anchors. With join, connect the averaged end points afterwards (Average & Join)

axis.description: horizontal: same y (a horizontal line); vertical: same x; both: one point

join.description: Join the end points afterwards. Default false

selectedPointsOnly.description: Only anchor points selected with the Direct Selection tool. Default false: every anchor of the targets

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)
